Period.description: A concrete period with start/end dates and actual/forecast flag.

is_actual.description: True when this period is part of the "actuals" subset.

PeriodCalendar.description:
Calendar context that bounds and steps period identifiers.

An unprefixed identifier belongs to `Gregorian`, an `FY` identifier to
`Fiscal(config)`. A [`PeriodPlan`] retains its calendar once; operations
that resolve or step an identifier take this context explicitly (record
CORE-CONVENTIONS-014 #4).

oneOf.description: Fiscal years opening on the configured month and day.

PeriodId.description:
Identifier for a Gregorian period like `2025Q1` or a fiscal period like
`FY2025W53`.

description: Ordered reporting periods with their calendar bounds and actual/forecast flags.

calendar.description: Calendar context of every period in the plan, retained once.

periods.description: Ordered periods produced by the parser.

title: PeriodPlan
